name: Fade + Rise
when: Default entrance for cards, sections, list items appearing on load or scroll.
reduced_motion: Drop the translate; keep a plain opacity fade or show instantly.

name: Hover Lift
perf: Cheap; avoid animating box-shadow blur on large lists (paint cost).
reduced_motion: Keep a color/border change instead of the lift.

name: Press Scale
reduced_motion: Safe to keep (essential feedback); or swap for a background flash.

name: Staggered List
when: A list/grid revealing its items in sequence on enter.
perf: Cap stagger count (~12) so the last item isn't slow.
reduced_motion: Show all items at once, no stagger.

name: Scroll Reveal
when: Sections animate in as they enter the viewport.
perf: Prefer IntersectionObserver over scroll listeners; unobserve after reveal.

name: Number Count-Up
when: Stat tiles / metrics animating to their value when in view.
perf: Text updates only; throttle to rAF (GSAP does).

name: Shared-Element / Layout
when: An element morphs between two states/positions (thumbnail→detail, tab underline).
perf: Let the engine FLIP; do not animate width/height manually.
reduced_motion: Cut to the end state without the morph.

name: Logo Marquee
perf: Duplicate content once for a seamless loop; pause on hover.
reduced_motion: Render a static wrapped row, no animation.

name: Pinned Scroll Scrub
when: A section pins while its content animates tied to scroll progress (product story, steps).
perf: Expensive — use sparingly, one per page; test on mid-range mobile or disable there.
reduced_motion: Unpin and show content as normal stacked sections.

name: Split-Text Headline
when: Hero headline animating per-word or per-char on load.
perf: Char-splitting a huge headline is heavy; word-level is usually enough.

name: Layered Parallax
when: Depth via layers moving at different scroll speeds (hero backgrounds).
gsap: ScrollTrigger scrub with different y on each layer.
perf: Transform-only; keep layers few; can cost on mobile — consider disabling.

name: Magnetic / Cursor Follow
when: Buttons or elements subtly follow the cursor (agency/portfolio flair).
